title: AggregateWindowChangedPayload
description: Payload of the AggregateWindowChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the window belongs to.

businessUnitRef.description: The business unit of the window. A producer always sends both businessUnitRef and aggregateType; a consumer refuses an event that has one without the other. The member is optional in the schema only because the schema is additive-only within a major version (API-41).

aggregateType.description: The category of the window. A producer always sends both businessUnitRef and aggregateType; a consumer refuses an event that has one without the other. The member is optional in the schema only because the schema is additive-only within a major version (API-41).

periodRef.description: Prescribed period reference, when the window is period-aligned.

state.description: Window state. MISSED means a due window part whose closing run could not make its aggregate; a later CLOSED for the same part clears it.

findingCode.description: The code of catalogue/errors/error-codes.yaml for the missed window finding. Present only when state is MISSED.

spanKnown.description: Absent or true: the window part has a known period span. False, only with state MISSED: a held window whose span is not known; prescribedPeriod is then exactly UNKNOWN-SPAN, and window.from and window.to are the first and last day of the aggregation window.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate identifier, present when state is CLOSED.

stateVersion.description: The producer-owned counter of the key tenant, entityRef, prescribedPeriod, window.from and window.to. It starts at 1 and rises strictly with every event the producer publishes for that key. The counter may be shared by windows of several business units and categories, so gaps are normal for one window. A consumer keeps its state and compares stateVersion per tenant, entityRef, prescribedPeriod, window.from, window.to, businessUnitRef and aggregateType; events with neither businessUnitRef nor aggregateType form an identity of their own. A consumer applies an event only when its stateVersion is greater than the one it holds for that identity, and an event without it applies only when the consumer holds no row for that identity (fail closed). A producer always sends it; the member is optional in the schema only because the schema is additive-only within a major version (API-41).
